name: Grimoire of the Dead
oracle_text:
{1}, {T}, Discard a card: Put a study counter on Grimoire of the Dead.
{T}, Remove three study counters from Grimoire of the Dead and sacrifice it: Put all creature cards from all graveyards onto the battlefield under your control. They're black Zombies in addition to their other colors and types.
blocked_sentences: {T}, Remove three study counters from Grimoire of the Dead and sacrifice it: Put all creature cards from all graveyards onto the battlefield under your control. They're black Zombies in addition to their other colors and types.

needs.what: a one-shot, indefinite (no printed duration) effect that adds a color to the objects in a binding -- here the permanents a put_onto_battlefield recorded with `as` -- in addition to their existing colors, without touching their card types, base power/toughness or other characteristics ("they're black in addition to their other colors"; also Rise from the Grave, Necromantic Selection, Dread Slaver)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: add_subtype covers the Zombie half but carries no colors. animate is the only op with additive `colors`, but on a creature animation the loader demands `power` and `toughness` (which would overwrite each reanimated creature's printed size) unless `keep_pt`, and `keep_pt` is refused unless `objects` is self_only or a target narrowed to Vehicles -- a binding over the reanimated cards is neither. `types: []` falls back to Creature, and `keep_colors` only applies to an exact animation.
